create_TrainingPlotter: create a TrainingPlotter instance with custom max_timesteps, figsize, and max_cols parameters
update_TrainingPlotter_metrics: update the TrainingPlotter with current step count and metrics dictionary to render live training plots
save_TrainingPlotter_figure: save the TrainingPlotter figure to a file with 300 dpi and tight bounding box
plot_TrainingPlotter_reward_detail: plot reward detail metrics from eval/episode_reward/* keys with error bars and shaded curves
plot_TrainingPlotter_error_termination: plot error and termination metrics from eval/episode_error/* and eval/episode_termination/* keys
